name: tab-bar
title: Tab Bar
description: "The tab bar of a phone screen: two to five sections at the bottom in a floating glass capsule, an optional search or prominent tab, minimizing while the content scrolls. Desktop layouts navigate with a Sidebar or Tabs, so a tab bar never renders from 768px up."
docs: Import as `import { TabBar, TabBarItem } from '@/components/ui/tab-bar'`. See https://plexui.com/vue/components/tab-bar for props and examples.
